project_type: Vite + Firebase (Firestore) Progressive Web App — 'Nusantara ERP' v3.3.0. Mixed architecture: Vite-bundled ES modules in src/, plus a runtime-loaded 'classic' IIFE script layer in public/classic/ that holds most ERP business logic.
language: JavaScript (ES modules + classic IIFE), TypeScript for type-check only (.d.ts + tests). happy-dom test env.
build_system: Vite 8. A custom Vite plugin (classicBundlePlugin in vite.config.js) concatenates public/classic/**/*.js into /classic/bundle.js in dependency order (array `classicAll`) and serves lazy view chunks. Any NEW classic file MUST be added to the `classicAll` array in vite.config.js at the correct position, or it will not load. src/main.js loads the bundle via a <script> tag after auth + loadDB.
test_framework: Vitest + happy-dom. Tests that exercise classic IIFE modules import them from ../public/classic/core/ (the IIFE attaches globals to window under happy-dom), then set window.DB and call the exposed window.X global. See tests/cost-ledger.test.ts, tests/gl.test.ts, tests/doc-engine.test.ts, tests/erp-flow.test.ts for the exact pattern. tests/setup.ts is global setup.
test_command: npm run test:run  (alias for vitest run). Use `npx vitest run` if the script wrapper is noisy.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run test:run — all tests must pass (baseline 224 pass / 18 files). 2) npm run type-check — MUST NOT introduce NEW errors beyond the known pre-existing ones (see environment_constraints). 3) npm run lint — must stay clean (baseline: only a harmless .eslintignore-deprecation config warning, zero rule violations). 4) npm run build — must succeed. Add tests for new logic following the classic-module test pattern.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. /classic/bundle.js and /classic/view-*.js are generated at dev-serve and build time by the Vite plugin from public/classic sources; dist/ is git-ignored build output.
setup_instructions: npm install (Node >=20.19.0; sandbox has Node 22). Network is available for the npm registry (install succeeded).
environment_constraints: Network allows npm registry installs. No Firebase project / live backend in sandbox — the app runs in local-first mode (IndexedDB) and tests run under happy-dom, so no Firestore is needed for verification. KNOWN PRE-EXISTING type-check errors that are NOT introduced by this task and must be treated as baseline: tests/rbac.test.ts (Property 'RBAC' does not exist on Window — ~11 errors) and tests/twofa-flow.test.ts (Property 'twoFactor' does not exist — 1 error). PLAN_PARITY_NSA.md documents rbac.test.ts as pre-existing. Do not 'fix' unrelated pre-existing errors; just do not add new ones. NO email API is available: Section 2 live email ingestion (item 2.1) is DEFERRED — build a pluggable ingestion interface, not a live provider. Section 4 (Coretax export format) is DEFERRED — the exact spec is unavailable.
contribution_requirements: ATTRIBUTION CONSTRAINT (critical): the user is an existing contributor. Do NOT add the agent as author/contributor anywhere — not in commit messages (no co-author/trailer lines), not in package.json, not in AUTHORS/CONTRIBUTORS, not in code comments, not in doc credits. Match existing code style: classic files are IIFE-wrapped, declare NO top-level globals (shared global scope; redeclaration is a SyntaxError), expose exactly one window.X object, use var and ES5-ish style; src/ files are modern ES modules. Indonesian user-facing strings are the norm. Preserve NSA* JS identifiers (window.NSAMenu etc.) — they are internal wiring, not brand text.
key_patterns: DocRegistry (src/classic/core/doc-registry.js, window.DocRegistry) defines doc types SQ/PQ/SO/PO/DO/SI/PI/SR/PP/SRN/PRN/IT with statuses, transitions, collections, flowsTo. DO (Delivery Order) exists and getFrom ['SO','PO']. GL journals are DERIVED — GL.reconcileAll() rebuilds all auto-journals from source docs on every saveDB (gl-sync.js wraps saveDB). Never hand-maintain journals. rbac.js (window.RBAC, loads LAST) holds the PERMISSIONS matrix (roles: admin/manajer/akunting/penjualan/viewer/pending × modules), GROUP_MODULE for sidebar rail gating, VIEW_MODULE for view gating, and a saveDB safety net. nav.js (window MENU_CONFIG + window.NSAMenu bridge) defines the sidebar; menu-router.js (window.NSAMenu.handle) routes labels to *-extras open() functions. New feature views: add a MENU_CONFIG item + a menu-router ROUTE + an open() on an extras global. Goods Receipt ('Penerimaan Barang', collection goodsReceipts) exists in sales-purchase-extras.js (openReceiveItem) with items[{itemId,itemName,qty}], poId, supplierName, posted flag. NO weighbridge/timbangan, NO reconciliation cross-check, NO funnel diagram, NO SJ-vs-supplier-recap validation exist yet. helpers.js exposes idr()/esc()/badge(); modal.js exposes openModal/showToast. Sample assets in docs/pitch/ (Contoh_SuratJalan_Excel.xlsx = one DO sheet; Template-Import-Nusantara.xlsx has Delivery Orders sheet with headers Tanggal,Nomor,SO Number,Customer,Item Code,Item Name,Qty,Unit,Destination,Driver,Vehicle,Status).
